handoff.purpose: Final chunk: builds per-task result records for gated write candidates, distinguishing gate failures, lost artifacts, and held-for-promotion outcomes.

symbols.name: write_assignments
symbols.note: List of Assignment objects for write tasks, derived from write_idx.

symbols.name: write_gates
symbols.note: List of gate mappings (or None) for write tasks.

symbols.name: candidates
symbols.note: Result of gate_candidates() for the write assignments.

symbols.name: promotion_allowed
symbols.note: Boolean from _governance_verdict indicating whether promotion is allowed.

symbols.name: held
symbols.note: List of (candidate, why) tuples describing why each candidate is held.

symbols.name: held_by_task
symbols.note: Dict mapping task_id to hold reason.

symbols.name: base
symbols.note: Common result record fields for each candidate.

symbols.name: receipt
symbols.note: Provider receipt from _provider_receipt(res), may be None.

symbols.name: results
symbols.note: Output dict mapping write_idx positions to result records.

claims.why: When promotion_allowed is False, held is populated with each candidate and the governance reason string.

claims.text: sealed promotion: held for an explicit owner call to daedalus.kairos.gated_writes.promote_candidates
claims.why: In the else branch (promotion allowed), every candidate is held with this exact reason string.
When requested_auto_promote is not 'never', the legacy suffix is appended to the hold reason.

claims.text: Clean candidate, not (yet) submitted for promotion: held by policy or by governance -- see held_by_task for exactly which.
claims.why: For candidates that pass gates and have an artifact_path, the result status is 'gated_held' with reason from held_by_task.

claims.text: candidate passed its gates but its patch bytes could not be persisted after the attempt branch was reaped
claims.why: When res.artifact_path is missing, the result status is 'gated_artifact_lost' with this exact reason text.

claims.text: held for a human to promote (daedalus.kairos.gated_writes.promote_candidates)
claims.why: When held_by_task has no entry for the task_id, the fallback reason is exactly this string.

observations.what: The chunk relies on external functions (gate_candidates, _governance_verdict, _provider_receipt) whose behavior is not visible here; the correctness of the result records depends on their contracts.
The variable `auto_promote` is referenced but not defined in this chunk; it must be a parameter or variable from an enclosing scope, and its value is used to populate the result record.
The variable `requested_auto_promote` is referenced but not defined in this chunk; it must be from an enclosing scope.
The `results` dictionary is indexed by the original `write_idx` positions; if `write_idx` contains indices not in `assignments`, this could raise IndexError, but the chunk assumes write_idx is valid.
When `res.artifact` is not None, the code reads `res.artifact.diff_sha256`, `byte_length`, and `changed_paths`; if any of these attributes are missing or None, the code may raise AttributeError.
The `held_by_task` dict is built from `candidates` and `held`; if a candidate's `result.task_id` is missing or None, the dict key will be None, and the lookup at line 1158 will fail to match.
